_comment: BackMaster classroom policy. Installed to %ProgramData%\BackMaster\policy.json, writable by Administrators only. Edit it through the settings window; saving there asks for administrator approval.

schedule._comment: Scheduled = restrictions only during the periods below; AlwaysOn / AlwaysOff override the timetable. Times are read in timeZone, not the PC's current zone, so changing the Windows time zone cannot move a lesson.

filtering._comment: Blocked through the hosts file during lessons. Each domain is also blocked with www. in front; other subdomains must be listed separately.

access._comment: Global shortcut that opens the phrase dialog for the settings window. The phrase itself is stored only as a hash, in a separate file readable by Administrators.
